issues.main_description_html:
Implement preview page publish navbar

RESULT NAVBAR

  • branch github : UIUX-Create/preview-page-publish-navbar

  • Draft

  • published

RESULT MODAL

  • publish
  • share
  • unpublish

Source

  • Brainstorming source: docs/superpowers/brainstorming/2026-07-09-preview-page-navbar-brainstorming.md

Summary

Add an editor-like navbar to the preview page, with preview-specific publishing controls. The navbar should show MapThru branding, draft/published status, light/dark theme toggle, publish/unpublish controls, public sharing, and a live project link.

The preview navbar must feel related to the editor navbar, but it must not include editor-only actions such as save, file menu, collaboration sharing, add floor, or preview.

User Story

As a project owner reviewing a preview, I want to see whether the project is draft or published and manage publishing from the preview page, so I can publish, share, unpublish, or open the public project without returning to editing mode.

Required Behavior

Navbar

Add a top navbar to the preview page.

The navbar must include:

  • MapThru branding with logo.
  • Project status label: Draft or Published.
  • Light/dark theme toggle.
  • Publish button when the project is still a draft.
  • Share button when the project is published.
  • Unpublish button when the project is published.
  • View project live button when the project is published.

The publish and unpublish actions must be primary actions.

Draft State

When the project is not published, show:

  • MapThru branding with logo.
  • Draft status label.
  • Light/dark theme toggle.
  • Primary Publish button.

Do not show:

  • Share
  • Unpublish
  • View project live

Published State

When the project is published, show:

  • MapThru branding with logo.
  • Published status label.
  • Light/dark theme toggle.
  • Share button.
  • Primary Unpublish button.
  • View project live button.

Publish Confirmation

Clicking Publish must open a friendly confirmation modal before publishing.

Suggested copy:

  • Title: Publish project?
  • Helper: This will make your project available to everyone with the public link. You can unpublish it later.
  • Confirm button: Publish project
  • Cancel button: Cancel

Behavior:

  • Start publishing only after the user confirms.
  • If the user cancels, keep the project in draft state.
  • On success, update the status label to Published.
  • On success, replace draft actions with published actions.

Suggested feedback:

  • Loading: Publishing...
  • Success: Project published
  • Error: Project could not be published. Try again.

Unpublish Confirmation

Clicking Unpublish must open a friendly confirmation modal before unpublishing.

Suggested copy:

  • Title: Unpublish project?
  • Helper: People with the public link will no longer be able to view this project. You can publish it again when you are ready.
  • Confirm button: Unpublish project
  • Cancel button: Cancel

Behavior:

  • Start unpublishing only after the user confirms.
  • If the user cancels, keep the project in published state.
  • On success, update the status label to Draft.
  • On success, replace published actions with draft actions.
  • Unpublishing removes public access but does not delete the project.

Suggested feedback:

  • Loading: Unpublishing...
  • Success: Project unpublished
  • Error: Project could not be unpublished. Try again.

Share Button

The preview Share button must mean public distribution, not editor collaboration.

Requirements:

  • Show it only when the project is published.
  • Use copy that clearly says public link and embed code.
  • Do not include people, members, invites, permissions, or collaboration language.

Suggested accessible label or tooltip:

Share published project

Share Modal

Clicking Share opens a share modal inspired by Google Maps sharing behavior.

The modal must include:

  • Copy shareable link.
  • Copy embed code.

Share link section:

  • Section label: Share link
  • Helper text: Anyone with this link can view the published project.
  • Button: Copy link
  • Success feedback: Link copied

Embed section:

  • Section label: Embed map
  • Helper text: Use this code to embed the published project on a website.
  • Button: Copy embed code
  • Success feedback: Embed code copied

View Project Live

The View project live button appears only in published state.

Behavior:

  • Opens the published public project in a new browser tab.
  • Does not change preview page state.
  • Does not close the preview page.

Suggested accessible label:

Open published project in a new tab

Theme Toggle

The preview navbar must include a light/dark theme toggle that matches the editor navbar style.

Requirements:

  • User can switch between light and dark mode.
  • Preview page updates visually.
  • Selected mode is clear.
  • Control is keyboard accessible.

Required States

  • Loading publish status
  • Draft
  • Publish confirmation open
  • Publishing
  • Published
  • Unpublish confirmation open
  • Unpublishing
  • Publish error
  • Unpublish error
  • Share modal open
  • Copy link success
  • Copy embed code success
  • Copy error

Accessibility

  • Navbar should be a clear top navigation landmark.
  • Status should be readable as text.
  • Theme toggle should have an accessible label.
  • Publish and unpublish buttons should be keyboard reachable.
  • Publish confirmation should clearly explain that everyone with the public link can access the project.
  • Unpublish confirmation should clearly explain that everyone with the public link will lose access.
  • Share modal should have a clear title.
  • Share modal should trap focus while open.
  • Escape should close the share modal.
  • Copy buttons should announce success feedback.
  • View project live should communicate that it opens a new tab.
  • Loading and error states should not rely on color alone.

Non-Goals

  • Do not redesign the preview map itself.
  • Do not add editor drawing tools to preview.
  • Do not add the editor file menu to preview.
  • Do not add save controls to preview.
  • Do not make the preview Share button a collaboration invite feature.
  • Do not add member permissions to the share modal.
  • Do not redesign the public live project page.
  • Do not change how the editor navbar works.

Acceptance Criteria

  • The preview page has a navbar that visually resembles the editor navbar.
  • The navbar shows MapThru branding with logo.
  • The navbar shows Draft when the project is not published.
  • Draft state shows a primary Publish button.
  • Clicking Publish opens a confirmation modal before publishing.
  • The publish confirmation explains that everyone with the public link can access the project.
  • The user can cancel publishing and remain in draft state.
  • Draft state does not show Share, Unpublish, or View project live.
  • The navbar shows Published when the project is published.
  • Published state shows Share, primary Unpublish, and View project live.
  • Clicking Unpublish opens a confirmation modal before unpublishing.
  • The unpublish confirmation explains that people will no longer be able to access the public project.
  • The user can cancel unpublishing and remain in published state.
  • Share opens a modal for public sharing, not collaboration.
  • The share modal includes Copy link.
  • The share modal includes Copy embed code.
  • Copy actions show success feedback.
  • View project live opens the live project in a new tab.
  • Publish and unpublish states update the navbar labels and actions.
  • Light/dark theme toggle is available.
  • The layout works on desktop and mobile.

Verification

  • Add or update focused tests where practical for preview navbar states and modal behavior.
  • Verify draft state, publish confirmation, published state, unpublish confirmation, share modal, and copy actions manually.
  • Run lint/typecheck/test commands required by the repo before marking complete.
